x1.description: scalar or array. Specifies the dividend.
constraints: x1 - x2 * jnp.trunc(x1 / x2) should be equivalent to the result

x2.description: scalar or array. Specifies the divisor. ``x1`` and ``x2`` should either have same shape or be broadcast compatible.
constraints: x1 - x2 * jnp.trunc(x1 / x2) should be equivalent to the result

output.description: An array containing the result of the element-wise floating-point modulo operation of ``x1`` and ``x2`` with same sign as the elements of ``x1``.

constraints: x1 - x2 * jnp.trunc(x1 / x2) should be equivalent to the result
